memory: I measured t(f) and rc(f) for nominal PTFE 0.18/0.25/0.30 mm across 0–0.8 N. Fits are approximately linear (see body). 0.18 mm is too thin; 0.25 mm at f≈0.35±0.15 N is the recommended stable working point (t≈0.227 mm, rc≈1.4 mm). No metal–metal contact up to 0.8 N. These t(f)/rc(f) curves are now boundary conditions for the axisymmetric EM model.
